sections.title: A Solar + Storage Supplier & System Integrator
sections.text:
Gaoteng Energy is a supplier and integrator of home and commercial energy storage systems — not a factory. We source a full series of proven inverters, LiFePO4 batteries, solar panels and balance-of-system components from a vetted supply chain, then design them into one reliable system for your project.

That means you get neutral component selection, competitive one-stop sourcing, and a single partner who sizes, sources and supports your system end to end.

sections.text: Whether you are powering a home, a remote site or a large facility, we size the right combination of inverter, panel and battery to match your load and budget.
